configure_firewalld: false
configure_cockpit: false
allow_management_nic_rewire: true
provisioning_provider: libvirt

tempxe_discovery:
  enabled: false

disks:
  - name: bootdisk
    disk: disk/by-id/ata-WDC_WDS500G2B0A-00SM50_20360F802744
    bootdisk: true
    device: 0
    size: 466
    use_full_disk: true

uplinks:
  - name: n0p0
    physical_network: lab_access_l1
    interface: enp2s0
    mac_address: "70:85:c2:d4:5a:95"
    networks:
      - zone: lab
        cloudinit: false
        pxe: true
        vm_network: true
        network_name: lab_nw
        tag: ""
        bridge_name: n0p0_lab_nw
        ip: "172.16.10.6"
        default_route: true
        tcp_open:
          - 22
        udp_open: []
        services_open: []

gpu_passthrough_host:
  enabled: true
  reboot_allowed: true
  disable_nvidia_host_driver: true
  auto_detect: false
  include_audio_function: true
  kernel_args:
    - intel_iommu=on
    - iommu=pt
  pci_devices:
    - "0000:01:00.0"
    - "0000:01:00.1"
  vfio_device_ids:
    - "10de:1f82"
    - "10de:10fa"
